_readme: PLACEHOLDER obscure-glass patterns for the customer screen. Edit name, desc, and privacy (1 = still see outlines, 5 = detail gone). placeholder:true shows the placeholder badge (hide all of them in Settings). pattern picks the glass simulation: rain, gluechip, reed, satin, cord, aquatex, pebble, flemish, narrowreed, gray, bronze. Add a row to show another tile; unknown pattern values fall back to a frosted look. Order in this list is the order on screen.

patterns.name: Rain
patterns.desc: Vertical ripples that break up the view, like rain on the pane. Light still comes through.

patterns.name: Glue Chip
patterns.desc: A crystalline, chipped texture. Shapes on the other side turn into sparkle and color.

patterns.name: Reed
patterns.desc: Vertical flutes. You get light and a soft sense of movement outside, not a clear view.

patterns.name: Satin Etch
patterns.desc: Even frosted etch. The strongest privacy here — light in, detail out.

patterns.name: Cord
patterns.desc: Wavy cord-like lines through the glass. People and objects soften into streaks.

patterns.name: Aquatex
patterns.desc: A fine woven texture, similar to taffeta. High privacy with a fabric-like sparkle.

patterns.name: Pebble
patterns.desc: Small rounded pebbles across the surface. The view becomes color and light, not shapes.

patterns.name: Flemish
patterns.desc: Larger hammered spots. More distortion than a tint, with some color still readable.

patterns.name: Narrow Reed
patterns.desc: Tighter vertical reeds than standard reed, so the view breaks up more.

patterns.name: Obscure Gray
patterns.desc: A gray privacy tint. Outlines are still visible, with less glare than clear glass.

patterns.name: Obscure Bronze
patterns.desc: A warm bronze privacy tint. Softens brightness and adds a brown-gold cast.
